rule: A v3 sitting is complete only when every v2 day that carried any of its verses was complete. Conservative by design: it can under-credit but never over-credit.
caveats: v2 rounds every reading to whole chapters, so a v3 sitting that covers part of a chapter still requires the whole v2 day that carried that chapter.

v2 places some chapters in the wrong chronological position (99 chapters drift, Psalm 90 among them). Completion is carried across by chapter identity, not by day number, so that defect does not propagate.
